name: Engineering ISO 3D Viewports
description: Injects 8 true orthographic isometric camera viewports into the project file.
description_full:
Adds 8 standard 3D orthographic isometric viewports (Top/Bottom Front-Left, Front-Right, Back-Left, Back-Right) to the project JSON file.

Calculated using true engineering isometric angles (35.264° pitch tilt) with orthographic projection enabled, ensuring uniform axis scale ratios for drafting and mechanical verification.

[Note: This plugin was fully vibe-coded, use with great risk.]
